title: Stage Manifest
description: Declares how apps/orchestrator discovers and runs one pipeline stage. Every directory directly under apps/extractors/, plus apps/reporting/, must contain a stage.json matching this schema for the orchestrator to pick it up. A directory with no stage.json is not a stage and is skipped (with a warning) rather than silently guessed at. The stage's name is always its directory's basename -- it is not declared in this file -- so a stage can never register under a name that disagrees with where it lives on disk.

$schema.description: Optional relative path back to this schema, for editor tooling only.

entrypoint.description: Path to the stage's executable entrypoint, relative to the stage's own directory. Must exist on disk -- the orchestrator fails startup if it doesn't.

runtime.description: How the orchestrator invokes entrypoint. 'python' resolves the repo-root .venv interpreter; 'node' uses the orchestrator's own Node runtime. Extend this enum (not a per-stage command string) if a third runtime is ever needed, so the orchestrator keeps control of how each is invoked.

order.description: Run order among enabled stages, ascending. Two enabled stages sharing an order value is a startup error, not a silent tiebreak. Convention: leave gaps of 10 between existing stages (10, 20, 30...) so a new stage can be inserted at a specific point later without renumbering its neighbors. apps/reporting is expected to sort last (order 1000) since it aggregates what every extractor stage wrote; the orchestrator enforces that no extractor stage's order exceeds it.

reads.description: The derivative this stage reads (EPOCH-416): the decrypted backup or iLEAPP's output, each produced by the processor. The orchestrator passes its id as --derivative-id and its directory as --derivative-path, and fails the stage before spawning it if that derivative isn't registered for the backup. Its facts are filed under that derivative (R7).

parserVersion.description: Required for any stage that writes facts through ingest(); omit for stages that don't (e.g. reporting). An incrementing integer, never text or semver, so 'latest' sorts numerically. This is the ONE place a stage's parser version is declared (EPOCH-404, R2): the orchestrator passes it to the stage as --parser-version, and the writer stamps it on every unit. Bump it whenever parsing or normalization changes what the stage writes; a bump re-ingests every file as a new unit beside the old rows (R8).

enabled.description: Set false to keep a stage's directory (and its stage.json) in the repo without the orchestrator running it -- e.g. a stubbed-out extractor that isn't ready yet. Preferred over deleting or renaming the directory, since the directory and its stage.json are also what CI / extractor-contract tests key off of.
